issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְיִקְצוּ מְזַעְזְעֶיךָ' means 'and those who shake you will awake/arise' (from קוץ, to awake), not 'those who disturb you will no longer rest' (which would require a negation like לֹא and a different verb). The Chinese adds '不再安息' (no longer rest), which is not in the Hebrew and changes the meaning.
